prompts.ins-day:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: standalone photographic background for a relationship website, no interface in the image.
Primary request: Ivory sheer curtain beside a large sunlit apartment window, soft blue sky and delicate clouds visible beyond. White cosmos flowers and delicate green stems in a simple vase are arranged near the lower edges and sides. Crisp airy morning, muted warm-white palette, naturally soft leaf shadows, realistic linen weave and gentle glass reflections.
Style/medium: polished high-resolution interior lifestyle photograph, physically believable materials and photographic lighting, no illustration.
Composition/framing: one continuous wide landscape scene, 1536x1024 pixels, 3:2 aspect ratio. Keep the middle 60 percent visually calm with soft low-detail tones and plenty of negative space for real interface content to be added later. Place the specified still-life accents mostly near the lower or outer edges, preserve the distinct window and room setting.
Constraints: Generate only the clean photographic scene. No people or human body parts. No words, letters, typography, logos, watermarks, writing, readable book spines or printed book pages. No phone, device, screen, UI, interface panels, buttons, border, frame, montage, grid or collage.
